description: §24.5: the nestings the HTML parser keeps compile clean. That covers HTML inside an SVG foreignObject, inside a MathML text integration point (mtext) and inside an HTML-encoded annotation-xml, a table written with its tbody, and a list nested in a list item.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S474 "⭐ RULED — FORK RULE row C amended: semantic impossibility may be PERMANENT" (the PERMANENT class); the code and its reading are a PA reading in the S474 review of #1727
rationale: §24.5 item 1 excepts the HTML integration points (foreignObject / desc / title; mi / mo / mn / ms / mtext; annotation-xml with encoding text/html or application/xhtml+xml). Item 2 refuses only what the parser repairs.
